fields.summary_ko.0: Truist raised Walmart (WMT) target price from $114 to $134 and maintained a buy rating, with 6% upside at current price levels and retail sentiment improving from neutral to strong.
fields.summary_ko.1: Walmart justifies premium valuation with expansion in advertising, marketplace and membership businesses, alongside 23% US e-commerce revenue growth and 30% Sam's Club online sales growth.
fields.summary_ko.2: CEO Doug McMillon expands market share through low-price strategy and digital investment, raising 2027 net sales growth guidance from existing 4–5% to 4.9–5.2%.
